trans-unit.resname: HTMLTemplateInvoice reads PS_INVCE_INVOICE_ADDR_RULES and PS_INVCE_DELIVERY_ADDR_RULES and hands the result straight to AddressFormat::generateAddress(). If the key is gone, json_decode returns null and PHP 8 throws array_key_exists(): Argument #2 must be of type array, null given. The invoice is generated inside validateOrder(), so the customer cannot finish the purchase. The repair writes the factory value back into both keys.
trans-unit.source: HTMLTemplateInvoice reads PS_INVCE_INVOICE_ADDR_RULES and PS_INVCE_DELIVERY_ADDR_RULES and hands the result straight to AddressFormat::generateAddress(). If the key is gone, json_decode returns null and PHP 8 throws array_key_exists(): Argument #2 must be of type array, null given. The invoice is generated inside validateOrder(), so the customer cannot finish the purchase. The repair writes the factory value back into both keys.
trans-unit.target: HTMLTemplateInvoice lee PS_INVCE_INVOICE_ADDR_RULES y PS_INVCE_DELIVERY_ADDR_RULES y le pasa el resultado tal cual a AddressFormat::generateAddress(). Si la clave no está, json_decode devuelve null y PHP 8 lanza array_key_exists(): Argument #2 must be of type array, null given. La factura se genera dentro de validateOrder(), así que el cliente se queda sin poder terminar la compra. El arreglo vuelve a escribir el valor de fábrica en las dos claves.
